{{Top|leg}}
A '''turbine''' was an engine component. Miniaturized turbines were used in [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] to mix [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] and [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] intake to produce thrust.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
